name: com.ware.maqui
description: An immediate-mode retained-reconciler UI framework for Unity. Declarative per-frame widget code over a pooled UI Toolkit backend, with window chrome, drag/drop, responsiveness primitives and a headless-testable pure layer.

samples.description: A minimal scene showing the Gui loop, a window and a few widgets.
Pointer interaction: a draggable handle driven through the interaction adapter.
